facts.fact: Cameroon's FY2026 bill proposes FCFA 874,046,000 for programme 380 Modernisation du cadastre, whose objective is a digital national cadastre, tracked by the share of communes with a digital cadastral plan and of plans digitised and georeferenced per year, says the Ministry of Finance.
